appearances.whereabouts: Leading the hunt for the stolen Horn of Valere, traveling south from Fal Dara through abandoned lands toward the Erinin
appearances.notable_actions: Sets a hard pace; orders searches of abandoned campsite and village; wrestles with doubts about the decline of civilization; buries Changu and Nidao despite their suspected treachery; examines the crucified Myrddraal
appearances.demeanor: Grim, driven, obsessed with catching the thieves; becomes brooding and philosophical about the decay of nations; shows brief kindness in burial rites

appearances.whereabouts: Traveling with Ingtar's party, hunting the Horn thieves
appearances.notable_actions: Tries to reconcile with Mat and Perrin but is rebuffed; enters a house in the abandoned village and experiences a terrifying vision; uses the void and saidin to break free from the vision; observes the crucified Myrddraal
appearances.demeanor: Isolated, troubled, frustrated by ornate clothes and others' perceptions of him; terrified during the vision; determined not to be used

appearances.whereabouts: Riding with Ingtar's party, tracking the thieves by scent
appearances.notable_actions: Leads the party on the trail south; detects violence and 'something worse'; becomes increasingly nervous; identifies changes in the trail direction
appearances.demeanor: Nervous, uneasy, particularly troubled by the wrongness he smells; hunched and trying to hide

appearances.whereabouts: Traveling with Ingtar's party, searching for the dagger
appearances.notable_actions: Avoids Rand; sneers at Rand's coat; examines burned bone at campsite; searches houses in the village; appears healthy
appearances.demeanor: Scornful toward Rand, reluctant, driven by need to find the dagger from Shadar Logoth

appearances.notable_actions: Avoids Rand but is urged by Mat; uses enhanced smell to detect wrongness; predicts things will be worse; examines the village with foreboding; makes a growling sound at the flayed bodies
appearances.demeanor: Uneasy, foreboding, sensitive to smells and wrongness; golden eyes shining; reluctant to interact with Rand

appearances.notable_actions: Enjoys running when dismounted; explains Shienaran burial customs; provides historical context on fallen nations; discusses Aiel culture and the Waste
appearances.demeanor: Cheerful about running, knowledgeable, helpful in explaining customs and history

appearances.whereabouts: Traveling with Ingtar's party as a veteran soldier
appearances.notable_actions: Examines tracks and estimates their progress; leads search of village houses; sees a woman in white at a window who vanishes; cuffs Masema for wasting food on Rand
appearances.demeanor: Blunt, experienced, treats everyone equally regardless of rank; agitated when the woman disappears; gives good advice despite harsh tongue

appearances.notable_actions: Stirs the stew at camp; deliberately spills stew near Rand; stares at Rand with fixed hostile grin; scouts the ferry crossing
appearances.demeanor: Hostile toward Rand due to his Aiel-like appearance; cold, unfriendly

appearances.whereabouts: Traveling with Ingtar's party as a scout
appearances.notable_actions: Scouts the far bank of the Erinin with Masema; discovers the flayed bodies and reports to Ingtar; insists Ingtar must see for himself
appearances.demeanor: Dutiful, shaken and pale after discovering the bodies, unable to describe what he found

appearances.whereabouts: Found dead, skinned alive and hung from a tree by a river crossing
appearances.notable_actions: Previously suspected of letting Darkfriends into Fal Dara; murdered by unknown parties

relationships.description: Uno is an experienced veteran who gives good advice to Ingtar despite his rough tongue; Ingtar respects his experience
Mat actively avoids Rand and sneers at him; Rand wants to apologize but Mat refuses contact
Perrin avoids Rand at Mat's urging; Rand wants to reconcile but Perrin keeps distance
Masema shows open hostility toward Rand due to his resemblance to Aiel; deliberately spills food and stares with hostile fixed grin
Loial remains friendly and helpful to Rand, explaining customs and offering reassurance
Rand owns and rides Red; the horse responds to his emotional state
Ingtar is sworn to Lord Agelmar and commands his oathmen
